<code><nowiki>{{ZoneLink}}</nowiki></code> renders a link to a zone page. The ordinary positional page-title form is the supported first-class form:

<pre>{{ZoneLink|Port Azure}}</pre>

The positional page title supplies the destination and the visible text. Use explicit presentation fields when they differ:

<pre>{{ZoneLink
 |Port Azure
 |link=Port Azure
 |text=Azure
}}</pre>

The link picker may supply <code>stablekey</code>. This is the exact advanced zone identity selected by the picker. It keeps a link attached to the catalog record rather than to display text alone. Editors normally do not need to memorize or type it. A stable-key-only form is intended for generated links:

<pre>{{ZoneLink|stablekey=zone:azure}}</pre>

Generated picker output may also carry an <code>image</code> fallback. ZoneLink currently renders a text link, so this metadata does not add a visible image and should normally be left unchanged.

== Parameters ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter
! Description
|-
| <code>1</code>
| Zone page and default display text. The first positional page-title parameter is the usual form.
|-
| <code>stablekey</code>
| Exact advanced zone identity selected automatically by the Erenshor link picker. Usually leave this to generated links.
|-
| <code>link</code> or <code>page</code>
| Explicit destination page.
|-
| <code>text</code>
| Visible link text.
|-
| <code>image</code>
| Picker-owned fallback image metadata. ZoneLink currently renders no image.
|}
